thread:
maria: Heads up 1: prepping a focused migration doc for v1->v2 that callers will actually read. Goal: one page with quick detection steps, short fixes, and copy-paste SDK snippets. Need owners for three mini sections: SDK param rename, embedding dim delta, and docs redirects.

cheng: I can own SDK param rename. Quick thought: show before/after config + a tiny runtime-safe shim. Keep JS example tiny.

maria: Perfect. Keep the shim explicit but warn about logs spamming if customers wrap it in a loop.

cheng: Agreed. Example I'll add to the guide: ```js
// thin compatibility layer
const { model, ...rest } = opts;
const finalModel = model || opts.model_id;
if (opts.model_id && !model) console.warn('[deprec] model_id -> model');
```

noah: For embedding dims: propose a short two-paragraph section: (1) detect at call time (check `embedding.length`), (2) impact (index reindexing, similarity shifts), (3) three mitigations: pin alias, projection helper, or rebuild index.

maria: Good. We should include a minimal production-friendly snippet to detect mismatch and auto-fallback to alias.

noah: I'll add this tiny snippet for the docs (pseudo): ```py
vec = client.embeddings.create(model='redwood-embed', input=text)
if len(vec) != EXPECTED:
    # try alias that preserves dims
    vec = client.embeddings.create(model='redwood-embed-compat', input=text)
```

cheng: Also call out that some vector DBs accept variable dims if you re-create the index; include one-liner for Pinecone/Weaviate common gotcha.

maria: Yes, include a short "Vector DB notes" subsection. Taylor, can you take redirects and examples repo updates?

taylor: On it. I'll add a docs redirect rule and update the sample app (examples/search-embeddings) to defer to EXPECTED_DIM const instead of hardcoding 1536. Will file the examples PR (#3050).

maria: Timeline: want docs merged 72h before prod switch. Release-bot what's the tentative prod date?

release-bot: Tentative prod migration scheduled: 2026-10-12 04:00 UTC. Canary: 2026-10-09 18:00 UTC.

maria: OK. Action items I'm adding to the PR description:
- SDK snippet + compatibility shim (owner: cheng)
- Embedding dim detect + fallback examples + link to projection helper (owner: noah)
- Examples repo update + redirect rule (owner: taylor)
- Short changelog entry and email copy-points for Marketing (owner: maria)

cheng: Filing SDK PR now (#3021). I'll include 1-line testing note: "set both model and model_id in env to ensure shim triggers once".

noah: I'll draft the projection helper blurb and include an inline micro-snippet that demonstrates simple padding/truncation as last-resort.

maria: Keep wording actionable: detection (1-liner), immediate mitigation (2-liners), long-term fix (pin alias). Also call out telemetry: we should add a metric for "embedding_dim_mismatch" so we can measure customer impact.

taylor: Good call re: metric. I'll add a note in the PR to coordinate with observability for an event.

docs-bot: Reminder: add "migration checklist" section and mark engineering reviewers.

maria: Reviewers: @cheng @noah @taylor. I'll draft the Marketing copy-points and ping Emily separately.

taylor: ETA for examples PR is EOD tomorrow.

cheng: SDK PR in draft, tagging eng-runtime for review.

noah: Projection helper draft linked in the PR body and I'll add tests. PR #3077.

maria: Thanks all. If any blockers surface, drop them here. Quick note: keep all snippets <6 lines where possible 1.
